findings.current: a pair of river bandits famous in the area for being inseparable
findings.defect: The Korean describes the parents as a famous lovebird couple. “Inseparable” preserves closeness but loses the affectionate, couple-like image conveyed by 잉꼬부부 and present in the accepted baseline.
findings.rationale: 잉꼬부부 characterizes them as a lovey-dovey couple, not merely as people who are inseparable.
findings.replacement: a famous local pair of lovebird river bandits

findings.current: when your battery falls below fifteen percent
findings.defect: “Below” excludes exactly fifteen percent, while 이하 includes fifteen percent.
findings.rationale: The Korean says the warning appears when the battery reaches 15% or less.
findings.replacement: when your battery falls to fifteen percent or lower

summary: The translation is faithful overall, with two minor losses of source detail.
